description: Register a new account. Requires an invite code if the server has invite-only registration enabled.

main.description: Create a new account: pending until an admin approves it, or approved at once when the server approves new accounts automatically (ACCOUNT_APPROVAL=automatic).

handle.description: Requested handle: the name (3-30 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens), optionally followed by this server's handle domain. The response gives the full handle.

password.description: Password (10-128 chars, must contain 3 of 4 categories).

inviteCode.description: Invite code (required if server has invite-only registration).

status.description: 'pending' (an admin approves it) or, when the server approves new accounts automatically, 'approved' (it can sign in at once).

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing required fields or validation failed.

errors.name: InviteRequired
errors.description: Invite code required but not provided.

errors.name: InviteUsed
errors.description: Invite code has been fully used.

errors.name: AccountExists
errors.description: Handle or email already in use.

errors.name: InviteBound
errors.description: Invite code is bound to a different email address.

errors.name: IdentityCreationFailed
errors.description: Failed to create required identity material.

errors.name: CustodyModeNotAllowed
errors.description: This server does not allow custodial accounts (IDENTITY_CUSTODY_ALLOWED).
